name: product-catalogue
description: Product catalogue PoC: React web client + Node.js API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @catalogue/api" "npm run dev -w @catalogue/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @catalogue/api && npm run build -w @catalogue/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
